title: About the Daurah Hidayah al-Qur’an Program
hero_subtext: This program offers gradual study to understand the messages, guidance, and practical application of the Qur’an’s hidayah in life.
overview_paragraphs: The Science of Quranic Hidayah is the discipline that discusses messages and guidance drawn from the verses of the Noble Qur’an to guide human life.

Its difference from tafsir is that tafsir places greater emphasis on explaining the meanings of verses in depth, while the Science of Quranic Hidayah places greater emphasis on extracting practical messages from the verses for implementation.
books_intro: The Daurah Hidayah al-Qur’an materials are arranged based on the books that will be studied, namely:
books: Introduction to the Science of Hidayah al-Qur’an
Principles and Rules of Hidayah al-Qur’an
The Science of Deriving Hidayah from the Qur’an
The Methods of Scholars in Extracting Hidayah al-Qur’an
The Application of Hidayah al-Qur’an in Life
system_items: Instruction uses Arabic as the language of delivery.
The program is conducted as an online face-to-face class through Zoom Meeting.
The materials are arranged around 8 Hidayah al-Qur’an books studied gradually.
Each book is studied in approximately 28 meetings, with a frequency of 3 times per week, so the duration of study for each book is around 2–2.5 months.
requirements_items: Participants must be Bachelor’s degree (S1) graduates from Islamic Studies or Arabic Language majors.
Participants must have adequate Arabic language ability.
Participants must pass the interview selection organized by Markaz Tadarus Indonesia.
Registered participants are encouraged to have the Hidayah Quraniyah books as support throughout the program.
Certificates will be given to participants who complete at least 1 book in accordance with the program provisions.
Participants are required to attend the learning process actively and with discipline throughout the program.
Participants who withdraw after the program begins are required to provide an infaq contribution in accordance with the program provisions.
class_schedule_items: Class days: One day within the range of Monday–Friday, as well as Saturday and Sunday
Study time: Conducted after Fajr or after Isha
fees_items: Cost of purchasing the Hidayah Quraniyah books: Rp 150,000 (excluding shipping).
Certificate: Rp 100,000 per daurah or per completed book.
